# Repository traffic metrics

Generated by [`.github/workflows/track-traffic.yml`](https://github.com/microsoft/XBOX-Godot-Sample/blob/main/.github/workflows/track-traffic.yml)
on `main`. **Do not edit these files by hand** — the next scheduled run rewrites them.

This branch is an *orphan*: it shares no history with `main` and contains no
source code, so it never interacts with the build or the PR gates.

## Why this branch exists

GitHub keeps repository traffic data for a rolling **14 days**, then deletes it.
It cannot be backfilled. These CSVs are the only durable record.

## Files

| File | Grain | Key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data/clones.csv` | one row per UTC day | `date` |
| `data/views.csv` | one row per UTC day | `date` |
| `data/referrers.csv` | top 10, per snapshot | `snapshot_date` + `referrer` |
| `data/paths.csv` | top 10, per snapshot | `snapshot_date` + `path` |

`count` is total events; `uniques` is distinct actors.

## Reading the data correctly

**`clones.csv` / `views.csv` are true daily values.** One row per day. Safe to
sum, average, or chart directly.

**`referrers.csv` / `paths.csv` are NOT daily values.** Each row is the
*trailing-14-day total* as it stood on `snapshot_date`. Consecutive snapshots
overlap by 13 days, so **summing these across dates massively overcounts.** To
chart them, either pick one `snapshot_date` at a time, or read the series as a
rolling window.

**`uniques` is never additive.** GitHub deduplicates actors within each period,
so daily uniques do not sum to weekly or monthly uniques.

**The newest day is usually partial.** The current UTC day is still in progress
when the snapshot runs. The next day's run overwrites that row with the settled
value, so the most recent row in any file should be treated as provisional.

**A gap means the workflow did not run.** If it is broken for more than 14
consecutive days, the missed days are permanently unrecoverable. Note that
GitHub disables scheduled workflows after 60 days of repository inactivity.

## Quick look

```bash
git fetch origin metrics && git show origin/metrics:data/clones.csv | column -s, -t | tail -20
```
